package.name: humanoid_test_support
package.description: What the workspace's tests share, so no test package keeps its own copy: the ADR-001 transport conformance suite every ActuatorTransport runs unchanged, the generated robots a test iterates instead of naming one, manifest builders, gmock matchers for the value-or-error results, and MuJoCo model loading. Header-only and ROS-free, and a test dependency only: nothing a robot runs links it.
